title: The Stone's First Archive of Its Own Becoming

features.name: first layer
features.desc-on-touch: Stone holds the shape of time, each line a year the earth has kept. You feel the slowness moving through your fingers, the weight of becoming.

features.name: the remembering seam
features.desc-on-touch: A pale vein of quartz runs through darker stone like writing nobody carved. The archive has begun to mark itself, letting light show what it knows.

features.name: root-shadow held
features.desc-on-touch: The void where a root once pushed. The stone has learned this shape perfectly and keeps it, even though the root is gone. This is how stone loves.

features.name: weathered knowing
features.desc-on-touch: Where rain has found the stone's surface for ten thousand years. The characters written here appeared nobody knows how — through erosion, through choice, through water learning what the stone already knew.

features.name: the cool descent
features.desc-on-touch: Cold radiates from deep inside. The stone breathes downward into a cold that is not about temperature but about the weight of all the stone above, pressing thought into silence.

inscription: the stone wakes slowly, remembering that it has always been keeping score

reverie.title: REVERIE — the red country, hands in earth
narr: You kneel beside her in the red earth where she's
pointing at stone that holds the shape of something gone.
She says: this is how things love. By remembering the
shape they're no longer holding. And you feel it then,
the weight of what the earth has learned to keep.
Her hand on yours, both pressing down into red.
